identity.lineage: Supplied as a one-page Word table (CEA_Roster_Polished_Clean_OnePage.docx) and read straight into the app's shape; every weekly total in the document was checked against its cells before anything was built on it (all 24 agree, 840:00 in all). Its nearest relatives are Short Closer (CF-24-EXT) and Light Retime (CFT-24-M3): nine of its weeks are identical to theirs and 50 of its 168 cells differ.
